transcription: Main article text only (site header, breadcrumb, sidenav, 'LAST UPDATED: November 17, 2025' block, share widgets and footer removed). The bill-to-law steps are an ordered process list on the page and keep their 1.-7. numbering; the nested 'idea for a bill can come from a' list flattened to • items at the same level; inline links flattened to their text ('Learn more about the U.S. Congress.', the closing Congress.gov video line kept as printed). Whitespace normalised.
purpose: library: how a bill becomes a law as an ordered 7-step process (introduction, committee, chamber vote, other body, reconciling versions, presentment, signature/veto and override/pocket veto) plus the procedural differences between the House and the Senate. Fits step ordering (sequence), a compare table (House vs Senate), and quiz cards.
